selection_rule.eligible: All POD5 objects from complete HG001 listing, 73 per flowcell. No size filter.
selection_rule.rank: SHA256 of UTF-8(seed + newline + complete S3 object key), ascending hexadecimal, key breaks ties.
selection_rule.select: One rank-1 object per flowcell, 2 objects total.
selection_rule.read_inclusion: Every raw simplex parent in each selected object, regardless of length, quality, mapping or call outcome. Group known duplex partners for uncertainty. No outcome-driven replacement.
selection_rule.scope: Two ranked file clusters from one donor and one acquisition day. No whole-flowcell, population, unseen-by-vendor-training, or whole-genome variant-calling claim.
selection_rule.randomization_limit: Seed fixed by protocol, not a public random beacon. Selection is reproducible and outcome-independent, conditional on the published frame.

separate_expansion.rule: Minimum same hash within file-index strata 0-17,18-35,36-53,54-72 in each flowcell. Nominal hour strata need internal read-time verification.
